# Zsolt Szelepcsényi - Full Stack Developer

> Personal CV site of Zsolt Szelepcsényi, a full stack developer from Szeged, Hungary, with 9+ years of experience building web applications, SaaS platforms and business systems. Currently a Full Stack Developer at Aventail (since April 2026). The site is available in English and Hungarian.

Frontend-leaning, but comfortable across the whole stack: React, Next.js and Vue on the client; Node.js, Nest.js, GraphQL, Laravel and Yii2 on the server; Docker, Azure and Cloudflare for delivery; React Native and Flutter for mobile.

- Location: Szeged, Hungary
- Email: szelepcsenyi.zsolt@gmail.com
- Languages: Hungarian (native), English (professional)

## Experience

- Full Stack Developer, Aventail (Apr 2026 - present): custom business systems (CRM, ERP, B2B) end to end, from system design and integrations to the UI
- Frontend - Backend Developer, Evista Kft. (2017 - 2026): webshops, websites and web applications; REST APIs, Laravel / Yii2 microservices, React and Vue micro-frontends, Flutter apps
- Geoinformatics, Geodézia Zrt. (2015 - 2016): CAD / GIS processing of utility network data

## Selected projects

- Agropark (2026 - present): unified marketing, CRM and lead tracking platform for an agricultural machinery dealer
- Compera (2024 - 2026): supply chain sustainability reporting platform; Next.js frontend, Nest.js / GraphQL backend
- IndyKite Loyalty App (2023 - 2024): loyalty network demo with Google Sign-In, e-commerce flow and payments
- ChainFlow CRM (2022 - 2023): process-driven CRM with document generation; Laravel and JavaScript
- Podiart (2021 - 2026): medical desktop app rebuilt as a browser-based PHP / Yii2 system for foot analysis and custom insoles
- Trend Auto Szeged (2022 - 2023): UI/UX design and development of a used car dealership site
